name: How It Works
description: A process or cycle, step by step: the big picture, the steps, what causes what, a misconception, and a check. For biology, chemistry, physics and engineering mechanisms.
audience: Explaining a process, a cycle or a mechanism.

signals.why: the topic is a sequence of steps
the topic has cause and effect

slides.guidance: Lesson title for {topic} and a short subtitle that names the class level.
Students will be able to describe {topic} and say what happens at each stage.
The big picture of {topic}: what goes in, what comes out, why it matters. Three short points.
The steps of {topic} in order, each with a short label and one line of detail. Set isCycle only if it really loops.
What causes {topic} to start or change, and what happens as a result.
A misconception {grade} students commonly hold about {topic}, and the correct idea.

variants.guidance: A classroom meme about {topic}. Pick one format from MEME FORMATS that matches the idea, write captions a {grade} student finds funny and that make the correct idea easier to remember. Kind to students, never about a person.

slides.guidance: One question about the order or the cause in {topic}.
The process in one line, then the key takeaways.
